research_mode: official primary sources only; police open-data, ONS crime methodology and Home Office outcome-methodology gates; no parcel result, local risk score or business result claimed

sources.publisher: Single Online Home National Digital Team
sources.name: Police API service format
verified_claims: The Police API is a JSON web service using HTTP GET and POST requests.
limitations: A successful HTTP response does not establish completeness or suitability of the returned data.

sources.publisher: Single Online Home National Digital Team
sources.name: Street-crime radius query
verified_claims: Street-level crime can be queried within a one-mile radius of a latitude and longitude.
limitations: The query radius and anonymised points prevent premises-level interpretation.

sources.publisher: Single Online Home National Digital Team
sources.name: Street-crime polygon query
verified_claims: Street-level crime can be queried within a custom polygon defined by latitude and longitude pairs.
limitations: The polygon result is constrained by anonymised locations and does not prove incidents occurred inside cadastral boundaries.

sources.publisher: Single Online Home National Digital Team
sources.name: Street-crime volume limit
verified_claims: A custom area containing more than 10,000 crimes returns an HTTP 503 response.
limitations: A 503 response is a query-volume limit and must not be interpreted as zero crime.

sources.publisher: Single Online Home National Digital Team
sources.name: Stop-search approximate location
verified_claims: Stop-and-search locations returned by the API are approximate rather than exact.
limitations: Approximate points must not be linked to a person, property or exact stopping place.

sources.publisher: Single Online Home National Digital Team
sources.name: PSNI outcome availability
verified_claims: Crime outcomes are not available through this method for the Police Service of Northern Ireland.
limitations: Missing PSNI outcomes must not be interpreted as no outcome or no enforcement activity.

sources.publisher: Single Online Home National Digital Team
sources.name: Outcome location approximation
verified_claims: Outcome records carry crime locations described as approximate locations of the incident.
limitations: Outcome coordinates do not restore the exact crime location.

sources.publisher: Single Online Home National Digital Team
sources.name: Nearest predefined crime location
verified_claims: When latitude and longitude are supplied to the crimes-at-location method, the service finds the nearest predefined location.
limitations: The nearest location may not coincide with the query point or the true incident position.

sources.publisher: Single Online Home National Digital Team
sources.name: Scotland BTP coverage warning
verified_claims: For Scotland, the documentation warns that only British Transport Police data is supplied and displayed crime levels may appear much lower than reality.
limitations: The API must not be used as a complete measure of crime in Scotland.

sources.publisher: Single Online Home National Digital Team
sources.name: Persistent ID versus API ID
verified_claims: The 64-character persistent_id is intended to remain associated with a crime, while the API id is not guaranteed to stay the same.
limitations: Neither identifier is a police case number or proof that all revisions have been captured.

sources.publisher: Single Online Home National Digital Team
sources.name: Latest outcome status
verified_claims: The crime response can include the category and date of the latest recorded outcome.
limitations: Latest status is not a final judicial disposition and can change as a case progresses.

sources.publisher: Single Online Home National Digital Team
sources.name: Unmapped crime location
verified_claims: The no-location method returns crimes that could not be mapped, with location and location type set to null.
limitations: Null location must be retained as missing data rather than imputed to a parcel or neighbourhood.

sources.publisher: Single Online Home National Digital Team
sources.name: Date-specific category list
verified_claims: The crime-categories method returns valid categories for a specified dataset month.
limitations: A category valid in one month should not be assumed unchanged for all historical or future months.

sources.publisher: Single Online Home National Digital Team
sources.name: Available dataset months
verified_claims: The availability method returns available street-crime months and the forces supplying stop-and-search data for each month.
limitations: A listed month does not guarantee that every field or force is complete.

sources.publisher: Single Online Home National Digital Team
sources.name: API monthly update date
verified_claims: Crime data in the API is updated once a month and the last-updated method reports the latest data month.
limitations: The day component of the returned ISO date is explicitly irrelevant and must not be used as a daily freshness timestamp.

sources.publisher: Single Online Home National Digital Team
sources.name: Police API rate limit
verified_claims: The current API rate limit is 15 requests per second with a burst capacity of 30.
limitations: A client should not exceed the sustained rate or treat throttled responses as missing crime data.

sources.publisher: Single Online Home National Digital Team
sources.name: Police API throttling response
verified_claims: Requests exceeding the API rate limit return HTTP 429 Too Many Requests.
limitations: A 429 response requires retry control and must not be recorded as an empty successful result.

sources.publisher: Single Online Home National Digital Team
sources.name: Polygon automatic closure
verified_claims: The first and last polygon coordinates need not match because the service joins them with a straight line.
limitations: Automatic closure can create an unintended boundary and should be validated before analysis.

sources.publisher: Single Online Home National Digital Team
sources.name: Location-ID provenance
verified_claims: Valid location IDs are returned by other API methods that expose location information.
limitations: A location ID is an API mapping identifier, not a parcel, postal address or police incident identifier.

sources.publisher: Single Online Home National Digital Team
sources.name: Street-outcome volume limit
verified_claims: A custom area containing more than 10,000 outcomes returns an HTTP 503 response.
limitations: The volume error must not be interpreted as no outcomes and should trigger subdivision or controlled retry.
